Chapter 501: Chapter 6 Sensation (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan observed for a while and speculated in his heart.

In the Spirit Realm for nearly a thousand years, he devoted a lot of time to absorbing the various colored liquids from the Mysterious Gourd, greatly enhancing the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth.’

Next, he could reabsorb it in a short time.

After observing for a while longer, Lin Yuan’s consciousness returned to the outside world.

The expansion of the Inner World was an instinctual behavior and didn’t require Lin Yuan’s constant attention.

It only needed to ensure a sufficient supply of energy.

...

“My current number of Merit Points… twenty-six million?”

Lin Yuan glanced over and pondered.

The Eighth Stage Martial Tao’s price was twenty-two million Merit Points.

Of the remaining four million Merit Points, one million five hundred thousand were awarded to Lin Yuan for enlightening the Goddess of Wisdom about the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Evolution Paths contained within the bodies of those Supreme Beings.

Another one million Merit Points were conferred as a reward for Lin Yuan killing those two Eighth Layer invincible beings.

Usually, completely killing an Eighth Rank Different Species member was worth one million Merit Points, but killing an Eighth Layer invincible being earned even more Merit Points.

However, Lin Yuan did not completely kill those two Eighth Layer invincibles – their true bodies were still alive, so in total, he only received one million Merit Points.

But Lin Yuan was already content. Not to mention anything else, the treasures and weapons contributed by those two Eighth Layer invincible aliens, nearly worth five hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, had already made him a big profit.

The additional one million Merit Points were purely a bonus.

As for the remaining one million Merit Points, they were what Lin Yuan had accumulated previously.

“To ascend from a Seventh-Level Citizen to an Eighth-Level Citizen… requires fifty million Merit Points?” Lin Yuan checked the required number of Merit Points for the next citizen level and slightly shook his head.

Fifty million Merit Points was an astronomical figure, even for those Eighth Rank invincible Evolvers, it was something they could long for but never reach.

“No wonder, even though many are evolutionary scholars, they are not Eighth-Level Citizens…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Evolutionary scholars had opened up at least one new Eighth Rank Evolution Path, that alone was worth several million Merit Points.

In addition, every Evolutionary Scholar had their own research planet in the Central Star Domain, where they could deduce various achievements at any time, which was a substantial income of Merit Points over the long term.

Lastly, Evolutionary Scholars could join the human civilization’s Science Institute, the Evolution Institute, and still receive a steady sum of Merit Points from time to time.

Compared to most Evolvers, Evolutionary Scholars had many more ways to earn Merit Points.

Even so, a significant number of Evolutionary Scholars had not yet become Eighth-Level Citizens.

“Take it slowly.”

“As long as I can develop the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter… that should be almost enough to advance to the Eighth-Level Citizen…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, if the Eighth Stage Martial Arts were worth twenty-two million Merit Points, the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter couldn’t be less than that, which would be more than enough to move up to an Eighth-Level Citizen.

“Eighth-Level Citizen…” Lin Yuan looked forward with a hint of anticipation.

This level of citizenship wasn’t just about being a citizen anymore; it was about being a decision-maker in human civilization, even capable of influencing a range of Star Alliances.

The current Annan Star Alliance Council Speaker, for instance, was an Eighth-Level Citizen, whose influence was so vast that dozens of surrounding Star Alliances dared not take him lightly.

…

Outside the human borders.

A desolate Star Domain.

The great shadow of the Insect Race Honored Envoy descended, and several other towering figures also coalesced.

“What’s with that Galaxy Master? How long has he stepped into the Eighth Layer, and he already has the power to kill an Eighth Layer invincible?” one towering figure spoke, his tone somewhat skeptical.

To them, Eighth Layer invincibles were not a big deal, but the Galaxy Master was so young; having grown so much so quickly, what would become of him in the future?

“Carnalan, you are most informed about the assassination of the Galaxy Master. What exactly happened?” The second towering figure looked towards the shadow of the Insect Race Honored Envoy and frowned.

“The facts are as you know them,” said the Insect Race Honored Envoy.

She, too, had not anticipated this outcome of the assassination attempt; the Galaxy Master, having barely stepped into the Eighth Layer, suddenly became invincible at that rank, with a combat power that was unimaginably powerful.

“He didn’t borrow any external force?”

The third towering figure inquired.

This was crucial. If the Galaxy Master had relied on an external force to kill the two Eighth Layer invincibles, that wouldn’t mean much, as external forces were limited.

“This is the battle footage from that time.”

In front of the Insect Race Honored Envoy, scenes appeared, showing Lin Yuan confronting and clashing with the five Eighth Rank invincible aliens.

A moment later.

A few beings had finished watching the footage.

“Without relying on external forces.”

“That Galaxy Master has mastered at least three kinds of cosmic forces, all of them higher cosmic forces.”

“One of those cosmic forces should have reached the Third Realm…”

A few towering figures whispered among themselves, their tones filled with surprise.

It was not easy to comprehend the cosmic force, especially the higher cosmic forces.

The Galaxy Master comprehending three kinds of higher cosmic forces was even more extraordinary than killing two Eighth Rank Invincibles.

“No wonder he was able to kill two Eighth Rank Invincibles.”

“These three kinds of higher cosmic forces, when combined, can barely touch the threshold of the Ninth Rank. However, in other aspects, they are much more sophisticated than a mere Ninth Rank.”

A few towering figures exchanged glances with each other.

It was difficult for Ninth Rank powerhouses to kill an Eighth Rank Invincible because the latter would flee, activating their own cosmic force to hold off a Ninth Rank powerhouse for a moment.

Of course, the Ninth Rank powerhouses referred to here were the most common ones. In front of those powerful Ninth Rank beings, it was hard for Eighth Rank Invincibles to survive.

Although the Galaxy Master was not a Ninth Rank powerhouse, he had no weaknesses. The cosmic force of an Eighth Rank Invincible couldn’t affect him at all.

In contrast, the three kinds of higher cosmic forces that the Galaxy Master controlled could greatly restrict an Eighth Rank Invincible.

In simple terms, it was not that the Galaxy Master was stronger than a typical Ninth Rank powerhouse, but rather that those Eighth Rank Invincibles were suppressed by him.

“Three kinds of higher cosmic forces… Once the Galaxy Master steps into the Ninth Rank, he will grow by leaps and bounds. His chances of successfully reaching the Tenth Rank in the future are quite high…”

“Had we known earlier that the Galaxy Master had such great potential, our race should have sent Ninth Rank combat power to assassinate him.”

“Even if it meant tearing off the disguise, facing the retaliation of human civilization, the losses our race would suffer in large-scale battles in the future would probably be greater if this Galaxy Master were allowed to grow.”

A few towering figures talked among themselves.

They held a deep murderous intent towards the Galaxy Master, but they also knew that by revealing his strength, the Galaxy Master would definitely attract the attention of human civilization.

Sending a Ninth Rank powerhouse to assassinate the Galaxy Master now was already too late.

They might not succeed and could instead be ambushed by the powerful being of human civilization, risking their very own lives.

…

On the Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In his inner world, the Tai Micro Clear Crystal, which had accumulated to the size of fifty stars, was almost completely consumed.

And Lin Yuan’s inner world had smoothly expanded to a radius of thirty-seven million five hundred thousand miles.

This was his inner world after a fivefold amplification. The basic size should be about seven million five hundred thousand miles in radius.

“Now I can start absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd…” Lin Yuan immediately took out the gourd.

In the Main World, the absorption of the Mysterious Gourd’s liquid by his physical body had stopped at the second type, the orange-yellow liquid. Whereas in the Spirit Realm, he had almost completely absorbed the fourth type, the green liquid, reaching an amplification of thirteen times.

Inhale.

Exhale.

Lin Yuan immediately began absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd.

His Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth’ had been greatly improved and could easily withstand the burning of the orange-yellow liquid.

Just over ten days had passed.

Lin Yuan’s progress in absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd had caught up with his progress in the Spirit Realm.

Rumble.

His inner world was undergoing a frenzied expansion. Without Lin Yuan’s prior preparations, the spatial fluctuations caused by the expansion could have potentially swept across the Milky Way Main Star.

“Finally…”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into his inner world.

At this moment, his inner world had reached its expansion limit, covering an area close to a hundred million miles,

Vast and boundless.
